explication: Foundry is a shared framework for biomolecular model training and inference, shipping four model families: RFD3 and RFD3NA for constrained all-atom design, RF3 for structure prediction, and ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN for inverse folding. The user-facing workflow is to provide a structure or design specification, prepare model-specific inputs, run the model or sampler, and obtain designed sequences or predicted/generated structures. AtomWorks supplies structure manipulation and preprocessing across model workflows. The graph captures documented capabilities and indexed module references; several model internals and the RF3 engine were not excerpted, so those links are shown as unverified.
